messages:
lina: quick UX poke: what if the Usage page had a compact aggregate toolbar at the top (Org total, scope toggle, search) and rows below that auto-collapse low-activity projects? sketch: https://redwood.app/s/agg-toolbar :mag:

omar: love the toolbar. auto-collapse helps a lot. we should show a small badge for collapsed rows like '5 invoices, $123'. keep totals tappable to expand.

terry: accessibility: ensure collapsed rows still expose meaningful text to screen readers, e.g., 'Payments — collapsed, 5 invoices, $123.45'. don't rely on color alone for badges.

joanne: copy nit: change the toggle labels to "Account" / "Project" (short + clearer for non-technical users). tooltip: "Switch scope" should read "Show account totals" for clarity.

lina: good call. UX detail: collapsed rows show sparkline icon + one-line token usage summary (text/embed/rerank), and a chevron opens a right flyout with full invoice list and export actions.

omar: performance note: main timeline API should return row summaries only. details fetched via /details on demand. also prefer returning a small sparkline path string rather than base64.

terry: keyboard flow: row chevron tabbable, Enter opens flyout, trap focus there. aria-expanded on the row button. add aria-live for async token count updates.

joanne: invoice copy: prefer "Recent invoice" in the flyout header and label the download button like: "Download PDF (rwd-20260501-12, $456.78)" for SR clarity.

billing-bot: Invoice processed: rwd-20260501-12 (amount $456.78) -> https://billing.redwood/invoices/rwd-20260501-12 :receipt:

lina: question: inline invoice preview vs flyout? tradeoffs: inline gives fast glance, but pushiness harms scan. thinking: show one most-recent inline summary and "View all" opens flyout.

omar: agree on that compromise. also add a small "Export CSV" action on the row dropdown for quick finance exports.

terry: color/contrast: ensure sparkline + badge meet 4.5:1 and test with colorblind simulator. also provide text for sparklines like "7-day spend sparkline, peak on 2026-03-12".

joanne: last tiny copy tweak: swap "Token count" -> "Token usage" and use ISO dates (YYYY-MM-DD) in invoice lists.

lina: thanks team — I'll iterate on the mock: toolbar + auto-collapse rules + one-inline-recent + right flyout patterns. will include an accessibility checklist and small API contract for the lazy details. sharing tomorrow AM. :white_check_mark:
